_comment: Front-page news feed. Newest first. tag: new|update|data|community. Edit this file (or add a curator post endpoint later) to update the feed.

items.title: Lab tools: CRISPR guides, qPCR primers, and codon optimization
items.body: Design SpCas9 guides for a gene (with genome off-target checking), qPCR primers over its cDNA, and codon-optimize a sequence for Dictyostelium's AT-rich codon usage. Under Useful tools → Lab tools.

items.title: Compare expression and find co-expressed genes
items.body: Overlay the developmental RNA-seq profiles of several genes, and see the most co-expressed genes right on each gene record. RNA-seq is also now an overlay track in the genome browser.

items.title: Human disease models
items.body: Gene records now show human orthologs and their disease associations, plus a browsable Dictyostelium disease-models page — a starting point for using the amoeba as a model system.

items.title: AI-suggested annotations (clearly badged)
items.body: A third, machine-generated curation layer offers AI summaries and GO suggestions for many genes. It is unreviewed and always badged ‘AI’ — a starting point, never a substitute for curated evidence.

items.title: Welcome to Dicty@Duke (beta)
items.body: A modern interface over Dictyostelid genomes and curation: searchable gene records with structures and expression, a genome browser, BLAST, GO/phenotype enrichment, and a public REST API. Feedback and corrections welcome.
